author: GenWave
description: The first-party starter set of background music and short musical hits, every file CC0 (public domain). Eight instrumental loops for playing quietly under an ad spot's voices (swing, piano, upbeat electronic, jazz, funk, and a percussive island loop), three one-second musical hits for punctuating a transition, and two short signature clips. Loops by hernandack, OwlishMedia, wipics, Pro Sensory (Alex McCulloch), and congusbongus via OpenGameArt.org; hits and signatures from Kenney's Music Jingles (kenney.nl). Installed by the setup wizard on a fresh station.
